app.title: Prevent Sleep
app.description: Power settings, manuals, and processes from a GUI

pmset.title: Power settings (pmset)
pmset.description: Choose a power source, a setting, and a value. Administrator privileges are required.
pmset.adminNote: macOS shows an administrator authentication dialog on execute. Your password is never stored by the app.
pmset.remember: Skip password prompts (while the app is running)
pmset.rememberNote: Enter your password only once; subsequent runs need no password while the app is open. The password is never stored. After quitting, the credential expires with the normal timeout (about 5 minutes).

pmsetSettings.proximitywake: wake when a nearby device is close
pmsetSettings.acwake: wake when the power source changes
pmsetSettings.destroyfvkeyonstandby: destroy the FileVault key on standby

man.title: Manual pages (man)
man.description: Pick a command from the list to display its manual page. No administrator privileges needed.

manAbout.title: About this command
manAbout.man: The standard macOS command for displaying online manuals (man man: display online manual documentation pages). Give it a command name to see its description, options, and examples.
manAbout.usage: Pick a command from the list above (e.g. pmset, caffeinate, launchctl) and press Show. Names not in the list (options, etc.) are rejected.

top.title: Process monitor (top)
top.description: Take a CPU / memory usage snapshot. No administrator privileges needed.
top.note: Interactive mode is not supported, so this takes a one-shot snapshot in logging mode (-l 1). Treat %CPU in the first sample as approximate.

topAbout.title: About this command
topAbout.top: The standard macOS command for displaying sorted process information (man top: display sorted information about processes). The default sort key is pid, switchable with -o (cpu, mem, etc.).
topAbout.usage: Pick a sort key and process count, then press Snapshot. Only `top -l 1 -o <key> -n <count>` is executed; interactive mode and other options are not accepted.

about.title: About this command
about.pmset: The standard macOS command for manipulating power management settings (man pmset: manipulate power management settings). It manages idle sleep timing, wake on network access, automatic restart on power loss, and more. Administrator (root) privileges are required to change settings.
about.sudo: sudo — run with administrator privileges. Required because changing pmset settings must be done as root.
about.scopes: -a applies to every power source. -b is battery only, -c is the power adapter only, and -u is UPS only.
about.value: setting and value — the chosen option and its value. Only 0/1, minutes (0–1440), or hibernatemode (0 / 3 / 25) are accepted. Immediate actions such as schedule or sleepnow are not available.
about.disablesleep: disablesleep — enable / disable system sleep (0 / 1). Shown as SleepDisabled in `pmset -g` output.
about.on: ON (1) — the system no longer sleeps automatically. Use for long tasks or presentations. Power usage and heat increase, so switch back OFF when done.
about.off: OFF (0) — return to normal sleep behavior. The system then sleeps according to timer settings such as sleep.
